What is the license of the retrieved artifacts, and does it permit redistribution of derived splits?
Which exact release/revision of this source is authoritative for the benchmark?
On what date were the authoritative files retrieved?
Which download URL is authoritative? The candidate_source_url below is unverified.
Which approved seed produces the candidate-pool splits?

plan_assertions.claim: Lower alphaseq_affinity values mean stronger binding.
The release carries alphaseq_affinity, confidence bounds, above_background, sufficient_replicate_observations, campaign ID, iteration, parent, and exact binder/target sequences.

An unequal-length preference pair is eligible only with the same reviewed parent, target, assay campaign, and fixed context outside an alignable editable window, plus an ordering established by confidence/censoring.
